title: Microsoft Hearts ("The Microsoft Hearts Network") running under Windows for Workgroups 3.11

creator.capture: Nathan Lineback (Nathan's Toasty Technology page, GUI Gallery, toastytech.com) — inferred from site ownership; the image itself carries no byline, but the human player seat in the capture is labelled "Nathan" and the site's About page names Nathan Lineback as its author

software.product: Microsoft Hearts, title bar "The Microsoft Hearts Network"
operating_system_evidence: Archive page heading "Microsoft Windows for Workgroups Version 3.11" (capturer's own label)
16-bit Windows 3.x window chrome: control-menu box, single down-arrow minimise button, navy title bar, system font
Title bar name "The Microsoft Hearts Network", the name used before the Windows XP-era rename (Wikipedia: Microsoft Hearts, secondary)
Default opponent names Anna and Terri visible; Wikipedia (secondary) gives Anna, Lynda and Terri as the Windows for Workgroups 3.1 defaults and Pauline, Michele and Ben for later versions
software.game_version: not shown — no About box, version string or build number is visible, and none is stated on the archive page
version_limitations: Windows for Workgroups 3.1 and 3.11 cannot be told apart from these pixels; 3.11 rests on the capturer's page label.
The top seat reads "Bill" rather than the documented default "Lynda"; it may be a renamed or networked player. Not interpreted further.
A second Hearts window is partly visible at the right edge; the capture is full-screen 640x480 and it is kept uncropped.
software.software_release_date_note: Not verified against a primary source in this ticket. Secondary only: Wikidata Q17281123 gives Hearts P577 = 1992-10-01; Wikipedia dates Windows for Workgroups 3.11 to 1993. Microsoft KB 126746 (version history) exists only on web.archive.org, which was unreachable from this environment.

original_publication_date_note: Unknown. HTTP Last-Modified of the GIF is 2011-06-23T19:16:44Z; that is a server file time, not a capture or first-publication date. Wayback availability lookup returned no snapshot for the GIF, then HTTP 429 on retry.
depicted_event_date_note: The date the screen was captured is unknown.
access_method: Plain HTTP GET with curl, no login, no terms prompt, no CAPTCHA. The https URL 301-redirects to http.

transformations.steps: Whole capture, no crop; palette to RGB; exact 2x nearest-neighbour enlargement to 1280x960; centred at (320,60) on a 1920x1080 #111318 ground. No text, credit or annotation added.
Uniform LANCZOS reduction of the finished 1920x1080 frame to 1280x720, review proof only.
